top_signals.title: Many truckers don't feel like the rest of America about AI data centers as business booms
top_signals.summary: Sprawling data center components from HVAC systems to tubing, wiring and semiconductors arrive primarily by truck, a boon for a business hit hard by trade wars.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
